paragraphs.en: Email is an internet service that lets people send and receive electronic letters. These messages are much like postal letters, but they usually arrive much faster, especially over long distances. Sending an ordinary email is often free, once you have an address and a connection.
paragraphs.zh: 电子邮件是一种互联网服务，让人们可以收发电子信件。这些信息很像邮政信件，但通常会快得多，尤其是远距离发送的时候。只要你有邮箱地址和网络连接，日常发邮件常常是免费的。

sentences.en: Sending an ordinary email is often free, once you have an address and a connection.
sentences.zh: 只要你有邮箱地址和网络连接，日常发邮件常常是免费的。

paragraphs.en: To send or receive email, you need a device connected to the internet, and an email address. A common address looks like name@example.com. This is a general learning example; it is not a real inbox.
paragraphs.zh: 要收发邮件，你需要一台连着互联网的设备，以及一个邮箱地址。常见的地址看起来像 name@example.com。这只是一般的学习示例，不是真实的收件箱。

paragraphs.en: A clear subject line helps the other person see what the message is about before they open it. Formal messages often start with Dear, followed by a name or a title. They often end with Kind regards or Sincerely, and then your name.
paragraphs.zh: 一个清楚的主题行，能让对方在打开邮件前就知道内容大概与什么有关。较正式的邮件常常以 Dear 开头，后面加上姓名或称呼。结尾则常用 Kind regards 或 Sincerely，然后再写上你的名字。

paragraphs.en: You can add a file as an attachment, such as a form or a short document. In a formal message, writers sometimes say please find attached before they mention the file. It is useful to check the file name, and to look for typos, before you send the message.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以添加一个附件，比如一份表格或一篇短文档。在较正式的邮件里，写的人提到文件前有时会说 please find attached。发送前最好核对文件名，并检查有没有打字错误。

paragraphs.en: As with regular mail, people sometimes receive a lot of unwanted messages. With email, this is usually called spam. Some programs can detect a large amount of spam and filter it out, but no filter is perfect.
paragraphs.zh: 和普通邮件一样，人们有时也会收到许多不需要的信息。在电子邮件里，这通常叫垃圾邮件，也就是 spam。有些程序能识别并过滤掉大量垃圾邮件，但没有任何过滤是完美的。

paragraphs.en: Messages to close friends can be short and informal. Work or official messages are usually more complete and polite. These are general learning examples, not rules for every workplace.
paragraphs.zh: 写给很熟的朋友的邮件可以短一些，语气也可以比较随便。工作或公务邮件通常写得更完整、也更客气。这些只是一般的学习示例，并不是每个工作场所的规定。

paragraphs.en: You can also send a copy of the same email to other people. This is often called CC, or carbon copy.
paragraphs.zh: 你也可以把同一封邮件抄送给其他人。这通常叫 CC，也就是 carbon copy（抄送）。

paragraphs.en: BCC, or blind carbon copy, also sends a copy to other people. The difference is that it hides the names of the other recipients from each other.

paragraphs.en: A newspaper is a publication printed on paper and issued regularly, usually once a day or once a week. It gives information and opinions about current events and news. People often read newspapers to stay informed about their city, region, or country.
paragraphs.zh: 报纸是一种印在纸上、定期发行的刊物，通常每天或每周出一期。它提供有关时事和新闻的信息与看法。人们常常读报，是为了了解自己所在的城市、地区或国家的情况。

paragraphs.en: A newspaper can be delivered to someone's home by subscription. You can also buy one at a store or at a newsstand. Recycling of paper is common, and used newspapers may later be made into new paper.
paragraphs.zh: 报纸可以通过订阅送到家里。也可以在商店或报摊买到。纸张回收很常见，旧报纸以后也可能被做成新的纸。

paragraphs.en: Newspapers usually cover many topics. These often include political events, crime, business, sports, and weather news. They use photographs to illustrate stories, and they may also include comics, puzzles, or other entertainment.

sentences.zh: 你买票或买一日票时，不一定要先计划好每一条线路。

paragraphs.en: The same tickets may be valid for different kinds of transport, often with transfers included. Day passes and other multi-use tickets are sometimes much cheaper than buying several single tickets; this is general information, not a price list for one city.
paragraphs.zh: 同一张票可能适用于不同种类的交通工具，而且常常包含换乘。一日票和其他多次使用的票，有时会比连买几张单程票便宜许多；这是一般说明，不是某一座城市的价目表。

sentences.en: The same tickets may be valid for different kinds of transport, often with transfers included.

sentences.en: Day passes and other multi-use tickets are sometimes much cheaper than buying several single tickets;

paragraphs.en: A transit map can look complicated at first. Once it is explained, you can see where to switch lines to get to your destination. This is general information, not a map of one city.
paragraphs.zh: 交通线路图一开始可能会显得复杂。等有人说明之后，你就能看出该在哪里换线，才能到达目的地。这是一般说明，不是某一座城市的地图。

paragraphs.en: For underground lines, and sometimes for local trains, you may need a ticket already to be allowed onto the platforms. There may be turnstiles as a barrier. Tickets can often be bought in the area in front of the turnstiles.
paragraphs.zh: 对地铁线路来说，有时也包括市内火车，你可能要先有票，才能获准进入站台。那里也许会有闸机作为拦挡。票常常可以在闸机前面的区域买到。

sentences.en: There may be turnstiles as a barrier.
sentences.zh: 那里也许会有闸机作为拦挡。

sentences.en: Tickets can often be bought in the area in front of the turnstiles.
sentences.zh: 票常常可以在闸机前面的区域买到。

paragraphs.en: There are also different ways to leave the system. Some systems require you to tap or insert a ticket before leaving. Others only ask you to walk through a door or a turnstile. Even if you can leave without tapping again, you might still need to tap so you are charged the right fare.
paragraphs.zh: 离开这个系统的方式也不一样。有的系统要求你在出站前把票拍一下或插进去。有的只需走过一扇门或闸机。就算你不拍卡也能出去，仍可能需要再拍一次，才能按正确的车费扣款。

paragraphs.en: A train is often a practical way to travel between cities. Many stations also connect with a bus or a metro. These are general notes, not a guide to one country.
paragraphs.zh: 火车常常是往来城市之间比较实用的出行方式。许多车站也能换乘公共汽车或地铁。这些是一般说明，不是某一国家的指南。

sentences.en: A train is often a practical way to travel between cities.
sentences.zh: 火车常常是往来城市之间比较实用的出行方式。

sentences.zh: 许多车站也能换乘公共汽车或地铁。

sentences.en: These are general notes, not a guide to one country.
sentences.zh: 这些是一般说明，不是某一国家的指南。

paragraphs.en: You can often buy a ticket at a ticket office or at a machine. If you can, reserve a seat, or buy your ticket in advance, because a popular train can be full. On some trains a reserved seat is required; this is general information, not a price list.
paragraphs.zh: 你常常可以在售票处或售票机买票。如果可以，就预订座位，或提前买票，因为热门车次可能会满员。有些火车必须预订座位；这是一般说明，不是价目表。

sentences.en: You can often buy a ticket at a ticket office or at a machine.
sentences.zh: 你常常可以在售票处或售票机买票。

sentences.en: If you can, reserve a seat, or buy your ticket in advance, because a popular train can be full.
sentences.zh: 如果可以，就预订座位，或提前买票，因为热门车次可能会满员。

sentences.en: On some trains a reserved seat is required; this is general information, not a price list.
sentences.zh: 有些火车必须预订座位；这是一般说明，不是价目表。

paragraphs.en: Arrive a little early, especially if the station is large or new to you. Check the platform and the destination on a display, because the platform can change. Stand back from the edge of the platform, especially when an express train goes through.
paragraphs.zh: 请稍早一点到，尤其是车站很大，或你还不熟悉的时候。在显示屏上核对站台和目的地，因为站台可能会改。请与站台边缘保持距离，尤其是有快车快速通过的时候。

sentences.en: Arrive a little early, especially if the station is large or new to you.
sentences.zh: 请稍早一点到，尤其是车站很大，或你还不熟悉的时候。

sentences.en: Check the platform and the destination on a display, because the platform can change.
sentences.zh: 在显示屏上核对站台和目的地，因为站台可能会改。

sentences.en: Stand back from the edge of the platform, especially when an express train goes through.
sentences.zh: 请与站台边缘保持距离，尤其是有快车快速通过的时候。

paragraphs.en: Before boarding, wait for people to get off. If your ticket shows a coach number, wait in the right part of the platform. Do not block the doors, and sit in your reserved seat if you have one.
paragraphs.zh: 上车前，先等下车的人走完。如果你的票上有车厢号，就在站台对应的位置等候。不要挡住车门；如果有预订座位，就坐到那个位子上。

sentences.en: Before boarding, wait for people to get off.
sentences.zh: 上车前，先等下车的人走完。

sentences.en: If your ticket shows a coach number, wait in the right part of the platform.
sentences.zh: 如果你的票上有车厢号，就在站台对应的位置等候。

sentences.en: Do not block the doors, and sit in your reserved seat if you have one.
sentences.zh: 不要挡住车门；如果有预订座位，就坐到那个位子上。

paragraphs.en: Put your bags where they will not block the aisle. If you do not have a reserved seat, you can often sit in an empty seat that is not marked as reserved.
paragraphs.zh: 把包放在不会挡住过道的地方。如果你没有预订座位，常常可以坐在空着、也没有标成已预订的位子上。

sentences.en: Put your bags where they will not block the aisle.

sentences.en: If you do not have a reserved seat, you can often sit in an empty seat that is not marked as reserved.

paragraphs.en: If your bus is delayed or too crowded to board, you can go to a ticket office and ask about a train; this is a learning example, not a timetable for a real city. Keep your ticket until you arrive. This article does not review any real railway or station.

paragraphs.en: A city bus is part of public transportation in a town. A long-distance bus can take you from one city to another. These are general notes, not a guide to one country.
paragraphs.zh: 市内公共汽车是城镇公共交通的一部分。长途公共汽车可以带你从一座城市到另一座城市。这些是一般说明，不是某一国家的指南。

sentences.en: A city bus is part of public transportation in a town.
sentences.zh: 市内公共汽车是城镇公共交通的一部分。

sentences.en: A long-distance bus can take you from one city to another.
sentences.zh: 长途公共汽车可以带你从一座城市到另一座城市。

sentences.en: These are general notes, not a guide to one country.
sentences.zh: 这些是一般说明，不是某一国家的指南。

paragraphs.en: Unlike many trains, bus lines are often run by more than one company, and they do not always share the same plan. Check the times locally at a station or a ticket office.
paragraphs.zh: 和许多火车不同，公共汽车线路常常由不止一家公司运营，而且它们不一定用同一套安排。不妨在当地的车站或售票处核对时间。

sentences.en: Unlike many trains, bus lines are often run by more than one company, and they do not always share the same plan.
sentences.zh: 和许多火车不同，公共汽车线路常常由不止一家公司运营，而且它们不一定用同一套安排。

sentences.en: Check the times locally at a station or a ticket office.
sentences.zh: 不妨在当地的车站或售票处核对时间。

paragraphs.en: You may buy a ticket in advance, pay the driver, or pay a person who checks tickets on the bus. On some long-distance buses, you can reserve a seat. This is general information, not a price list.
paragraphs.zh: 你也许要提前买票，或把票款交给司机，或交给车上查票的人。有些长途车上可以预订座位。这是一般说明，不是价目表。

sentences.en: You may buy a ticket in advance, pay the driver, or pay a person who checks tickets on the bus.
sentences.zh: 你也许要提前买票，或把票款交给司机，或交给车上查票的人。

sentences.en: On some long-distance buses, you can reserve a seat.
sentences.zh: 有些长途车上可以预订座位。

sentences.en: This is general information, not a price list.
sentences.zh: 这是一般说明，不是价目表。

paragraphs.en: Bus stops are not always clearly marked, so tell the driver where you want to get off. To signal that you want to get off, you may press a button, or you may have to ask. Some stops are on demand only, so the bus may not stop unless someone asks.
paragraphs.zh: 车站不一定有清楚的标记，所以最好告诉司机你要在哪里下车。要示意下车，你也许可以按按钮，也许得开口问。有些站是按需停靠的，除非有人招呼，车可能不停。

sentences.en: Bus stops are not always clearly marked, so tell the driver where you want to get off.
sentences.zh: 车站不一定有清楚的标记，所以最好告诉司机你要在哪里下车。

sentences.en: To signal that you want to get off, you may press a button, or you may have to ask.
sentences.zh: 要示意下车，你也许可以按按钮，也许得开口问。

sentences.en: Some stops are on demand only, so the bus may not stop unless someone asks.
sentences.zh: 有些站是按需停靠的，除非有人招呼，车可能不停。

paragraphs.en: On a long ride, bring some water, and bring food if eating is allowed. Keep your most important bags with you. If there is a seat belt, put it on. If the bus is crowded, move closer to the door before your stop.
paragraphs.zh: 坐长途时，请带些水；如果允许吃东西，也可以带食物。重要的包请随身带着。如果有安全带，请系上。如果车很挤，请在到站前靠近车门。

sentences.en: On a long ride, bring some water, and bring food if eating is allowed.
sentences.zh: 坐长途时，请带些水；如果允许吃东西，也可以带食物。

sentences.en: Keep your most important bags with you.

sentences.en: If there is a seat belt, put it on.

sentences.en: If the bus is crowded, move closer to the door before your stop.
sentences.zh: 如果车很挤，请在到站前靠近车门。

paragraphs.en: If your bus is delayed or too crowded to board, you can go to a ticket office and ask about the next bus or a train; this is a learning example, not a timetable for a real city. An overnight bus can save a night in a hotel, but it can be hard to sleep. This article does not review any real bus line.

paragraphs.en: Restaurants around the world have different customs for ordering, eating and paying. Dining times also vary. A restaurant may take its last order early in one place, and open later in another. Check the opening hours before you go.
paragraphs.zh: 世界各地的餐厅，在点餐、用餐和结账方面习惯都不尽相同。用餐时间也不一样。有的地方较早就不接受新的点单，另一些地方的餐厅则开门更晚。出门前先看一下营业时间。

paragraphs.en: If you are short on time, choose fast food, street food or a buffet. Fine dining can be assumed to take a few hours. These are general patterns, not a promise about any particular restaurant.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你时间紧，可以选择快餐、街头小吃或自助餐。高级餐饮往往会花上几个小时。这些只是一般情况，不是对某家餐厅的承诺。

paragraphs.en: Street food is still common in many places. Where it is available, it is often a cheaper option, but do not expect a quiet place to sit around and chat. Cheap food is not always bad food.
paragraphs.zh: 在许多地方，街头小吃仍然很常见。有街头小吃的地方，价格往往更便宜，但不要指望有安静的座位坐下来聊天。便宜的食物并不一定就不好吃。

paragraphs.en: In some places, a cover charge is an extra fee added to the bill. In a sense, it is the amount you pay just to sit down. It may be said to cover bread or tea if the restaurant provides those to everyone.

paragraphs.en: Tipping customs vary a lot between countries. In some places, leaving a tip is expected. In other places, tips are refused. It is better to learn the local custom than to follow one rule everywhere.
paragraphs.zh: 各国给小费的习惯差别很大。有些地方，给小费是预期做法。另一些地方则不收小费。与其到处套用同一条规则，不如先了解当地习惯。

paragraphs.en: Chopsticks are a common eating utensil in China and some neighbouring countries. It is generally considered rude to play with them. In some places, standing them vertically in a bowl of rice is also very rude. These notes are for learning, not a complete manners guide.
paragraphs.zh: 筷子在中国和一些邻近国家是常见的餐具。拿筷子玩通常会被视为失礼。在有些地方，把筷子竖直插进饭碗也被认为非常不礼貌。这些说明只供学习，不是完整的用餐礼仪指南。

paragraphs.en: If you rent an apartment, there is often a usual way to do the laundry. Many buildings have a shared laundry room with washing machines. These are general notes, not rules for one building.

paragraphs.en: If you have a kitchen, you can cook some or all of your meals. Check whether there is an oven, and what pans you can use. Plan your meals so you can use up what you buy. Dinner can also give you leftovers for the next day.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你有厨房，就可以自己做一部分或全部的饭。看看有没有烤箱，以及可以用哪些锅。计划一下要做什么，这样就能把买来的食物用完。晚饭也可以留下剩菜，第二天再吃。

sentences.en: Check whether there is an oven, and what pans you can use.
sentences.zh: 看看有没有烤箱，以及可以用哪些锅。

sentences.en: Plan your meals so you can use up what you buy.

paragraphs.en: Rice, pasta, onions, and tomatoes are available in many places. Familiar packaged foods or spices may be different, or harder to find. If a restaurant is full, you might buy food to cook at home, or take leftovers to go; this is a learning example, not a plan for a real trip.
paragraphs.zh: 米饭、意大利面、洋葱和西红柿在许多地方都买得到。你熟悉的包装食品或香料可能不一样，或者更难找到。如果餐厅客满，你可以买食材回家做，或把剩菜打包带走；这是学习情景示例，不是某次真实出行的安排。

paragraphs.en: Long trips cannot always stop when you are hungry. What is allowed on a bus, a train, or a plane is not the same everywhere. These are general notes, not a rule for one company, and not a price list.
paragraphs.zh: 长途出行并不能总在你饿了的时候停车。公交、火车或飞机上允不允许吃东西，各地并不一样。这些是一般说明，不是某一家公司的规定，也不是价目表。

sentences.en: Long trips cannot always stop when you are hungry.
sentences.zh: 长途出行并不能总在你饿了的时候停车。

sentences.en: What is allowed on a bus, a train, or a plane is not the same everywhere.
sentences.zh: 公交、火车或飞机上允不允许吃东西，各地并不一样。

sentences.zh: 这些是一般说明，不是某一家公司的规定，也不是价目表。

paragraphs.en: Bringing your own food can make a trip easier. It can also help if you are allergic to some food, or have other special needs. Before you pack food, think about how easy it is to eat, how much space you have, and how long the food will last.
paragraphs.zh: 自己带食物，常常会让行程更轻松。如果你对某些食物过敏，或有其他特别需要，这样做也有帮助。把食物装进包里之前，先想一想：吃起来方不方便、占多少地方、以及能放多久。

sentences.en: Bringing your own food can make a trip easier.
sentences.zh: 自己带食物，常常会让行程更轻松。

sentences.en: It can also help if you are allergic to some food, or have other special needs.
sentences.zh: 如果你对某些食物过敏，或有其他特别需要，这样做也有帮助。

sentences.en: Before you pack food, think about how easy it is to eat, how much space you have, and how long the food will last.
sentences.zh: 把食物装进包里之前，先想一想：吃起来方不方便、占多少地方、以及能放多久。

paragraphs.en: A bottle of water can be useful even if you want to drink something else. Sandwiches, bread, cheese, and fruit often work well for a day-long trip. If you wash the fruit and cut the food first, you can eat it while the vehicle is moving.
paragraphs.zh: 即使你想喝别的，带一瓶水往往也有用。三明治、面包、奶酪和水果，往往很适合当天来回的行程。如果先把水果洗好、把食物切好，车还在走的时候也可以吃。

sentences.en: A bottle of water can be useful even if you want to drink something else.
sentences.zh: 即使你想喝别的，带一瓶水往往也有用。

sentences.en: Sandwiches, bread, cheese, and fruit often work well for a day-long trip.
sentences.zh: 三明治、面包、奶酪和水果，往往很适合当天来回的行程。

sentences.en: If you wash the fruit and cut the food first, you can eat it while the vehicle is moving.
sentences.zh: 如果先把水果洗好、把食物切好，车还在走的时候也可以吃。

paragraphs.en: On some buses, eating is not allowed, or is prohibited. Trains may have a place to buy food. On a plane, you can often eat and drink, but the food is not the same on every flight. Check the rules before you pack food for the trip.
paragraphs.zh: 有的公共汽车上不准吃东西，或者说进食是被禁止的。火车上也许有买食物的地方。在飞机上，你常常可以吃喝，但每趟航班上的食物并不一样。把食物装进包里之前，先看清楚规则。

sentences.en: On some buses, eating is not allowed, or is prohibited.
sentences.zh: 有的公共汽车上不准吃东西，或者说进食是被禁止的。

sentences.en: Trains may have a place to buy food.
sentences.zh: 火车上也许有买食物的地方。

sentences.en: On a plane, you can often eat and drink, but the food is not the same on every flight.

sentences.en: Check the rules before you pack food for the trip.
sentences.zh: 把食物装进包里之前，先看清楚规则。

paragraphs.en: On a busy bus or train, also think about other passengers. A strong smell may bother people sitting near you. Messy food or soup can spill if the vehicle moves suddenly. Choose food that is easy to hold and not too messy.
paragraphs.zh: 在拥挤的公共汽车或火车上，也要替其他乘客着想。气味太重，可能会让坐在旁边的人不舒服。如果车突然动起来，容易弄脏的食物或汤可能会洒出来。选容易拿、又不太容易弄脏的食物。

sentences.en: A strong smell may bother people sitting near you.

sentences.zh: 选容易拿、又不太容易弄脏的食物。

paragraphs.en: If the next bus is delayed, or a restaurant is full, you might take leftovers to go and eat them later on the way; this is a learning example, not a plan for a real trip.
paragraphs.zh: 如果下一班公共汽车晚点，或餐厅客满，你也许会把剩菜打包带走，稍后在路上吃；这是学习情景示例，不是某次真实出行的安排。

paragraphs.en: If you leave restaurants and shops that mainly serve visitors, ordering food may create a language barrier. Staff may not speak the language you use. Even if they do, it can still be hard to find out the ingredients in a dish.
paragraphs.zh: 如果离开主要接待来客的餐厅和店铺，点餐时可能会遇到语言障碍。店员未必会说你用的语言。即使他们会说，要弄清一道菜里有哪些食材，往往也并不容易。

sentences.en: Staff may not speak the language you use.
sentences.zh: 店员未必会说你用的语言。

sentences.en: Even if they do, it can still be hard to find out the ingredients in a dish.
sentences.zh: 即使他们会说，要弄清一道菜里有哪些食材，往往也并不容易。

paragraphs.en: A restaurant with staff who speak a visitor's language, or with menus in many languages, is sometimes aimed more at tourists. The food may cost more, and it may not be what local people usually eat. This is general information, not a price list.
paragraphs.zh: 如果一家餐厅的店员会说来客的语言，或菜单有多种语言，它有时更面向游客。那里的食物可能更贵，也不一定是当地人平时吃的。这是一般说明，不是价目表。

paragraphs.en: You can often get better or cheaper food in places that local people use. The downside is that staff there may not speak your language. If you can, learn a few basic words for food. This can open more options.
paragraphs.zh: 在当地人常去的地方，往往能吃到更好或更便宜的食物。不好的一面是，那里的店员可能不会说你的语言。如果可以，先学几个和食物有关的常用词。这样会多一些选择。

paragraphs.en: A translation app can help when you need to read a menu or explain what you want. If you already know what you want to eat, you can also ask a local friend, or staff at the place where you are staying, to write down the name of the dish.

paragraphs.en: You can also ask them to write a short, important message. One common example is "This person does not eat meat." Another is "This person is allergic to peanuts." A clearly written note can be easier to show than a long explanation.

paragraphs.en: Table manners differ a lot from place to place. In some places, people eat with one hand and keep the other hand for the toilet. Burping or slurping may be fine in one place, but very rude in another.
paragraphs.zh: 餐桌礼仪各地差别很大。有些地方，人们用一只手吃饭，另一只手留给上厕所时用。打嗝或吸溜声在一个地方也许没关系，在另一个地方却会显得很没礼貌。

sentences.en: Table manners differ a lot from place to place.
sentences.zh: 餐桌礼仪各地差别很大。

sentences.en: In some places, people eat with one hand and keep the other hand for the toilet.
sentences.zh: 有些地方，人们用一只手吃饭，另一只手留给上厕所时用。

sentences.en: Burping or slurping may be fine in one place, but very rude in another.
sentences.zh: 打嗝或吸溜声在一个地方也许没关系，在另一个地方却会显得很没礼貌。

paragraphs.en: In many places, eating with a fork and a knife is seen as good table manners. Some people keep the fork in the left hand and the knife in the right; others use the fork in the right hand. Cut one bite at a time; do not cut up all the food on your plate first. That is usually only for people who cannot use a knife.
paragraphs.zh: 在许多地方，用刀叉吃饭会被看作有礼貌的餐桌礼仪。有的人左手拿叉、右手拿刀；也有人用右手拿叉。一次只切一口，不要先把盘子里的食物全部切好再吃。通常只有不方便用刀的人才会那样做。

sentences.en: In many places, eating with a fork and a knife is seen as good table manners.
sentences.zh: 在许多地方，用刀叉吃饭会被看作有礼貌的餐桌礼仪。

sentences.en: Some people keep the fork in the left hand and the knife in the right; others use the fork in the right hand.
sentences.zh: 有的人左手拿叉、右手拿刀；也有人用右手拿叉。

sentences.en: Cut one bite at a time; do not cut up all the food on your plate first.
sentences.zh: 一次只切一口，不要先把盘子里的食物全部切好再吃。

sentences.en: That is usually only for people who cannot use a knife.
sentences.zh: 通常只有不方便用刀的人才会那样做。

paragraphs.en: How people use utensils also varies. In some places, people eat with their hands, often using bread to scoop up other foods. Some restaurants give you only a spoon for soup, or no knife.
paragraphs.zh: 人们怎么用餐具，也各有不同。有些地方，人们用手吃，常常用面包去舀起别的食物。有的餐厅只给你一把喝汤的勺子，或者不给刀。

sentences.en: How people use utensils also varies.
sentences.zh: 人们怎么用餐具，也各有不同。

sentences.en: In some places, people eat with their hands, often using bread to scoop up other foods.

sentences.en: Some restaurants give you only a spoon for soup, or no knife.
sentences.zh: 有的餐厅只给你一把喝汤的勺子，或者不给刀。

paragraphs.en: Using your own fork to take food from a shared plate is not clean in many places, but it is normal in others. Some people avoid touching food with their hands, and may eat a sandwich using the wrapper.
paragraphs.zh: 用自己的叉子从共用的盘子里夹菜，在许多地方会被看作不卫生，但在另一些地方却很正常。有的人不愿用手直接碰到食物，吃三明治时也会隔着包装纸拿。

sentences.en: Using your own fork to take food from a shared plate is not clean in many places, but it is normal in others.
sentences.zh: 用自己的叉子从共用的盘子里夹菜，在许多地方会被看作不卫生，但在另一些地方却很正常。

sentences.en: Some people avoid touching food with their hands, and may eat a sandwich using the wrapper.

paragraphs.en: At a buffet, get a new plate each time; do not take a used one back to the serving area. In many places, it is rude to rest your elbows on the table; rest your wrists instead. In some places your hands should stay visible; in others, they may rest in your lap.
paragraphs.zh: 在自助餐，每次取菜都要换一只新盘子，不要把用过的盘子带回去。在许多地方，把胳膊肘搁在餐桌上是失礼的，可以改搁手腕。有的地方双手要放在看得见的地方；也有的地方，手可以放在腿上。

sentences.en: In many places, it is rude to rest your elbows on the table; rest your wrists instead.
sentences.zh: 在许多地方，把胳膊肘搁在餐桌上是失礼的，可以改搁手腕。

sentences.en: In some places your hands should stay visible; in others, they may rest in your lap.
sentences.zh: 有的地方双手要放在看得见的地方；也有的地方，手可以放在腿上。

paragraphs.en: When you look for a place to eat, be careful of places that advertise a lot in tourist areas. Also be careful if people try very hard to pull you in. This kind of loud selling is common around places that many visitors pass.
paragraphs.zh: 找地方吃饭时，要小心那些在游客多的地方大做广告的店。如果有人很用力地把你往店里拉，也要小心。在很多路过的访客会经过的地方，这种大声招揽很常见。

sentences.zh: 找地方吃饭时，要小心那些在游客多的地方大做广告的店。

sentences.en: Also be careful if people try very hard to pull you in.
sentences.zh: 如果有人很用力地把你往店里拉，也要小心。

sentences.en: This kind of loud selling is common around places that many visitors pass.
sentences.zh: 在很多路过的访客会经过的地方，这种大声招揽很常见。

paragraphs.en: This is usually a sign that the food is too expensive, and that it is not very good. A large sign on a busy street does not, by itself, mean the meal is good.
paragraphs.zh: 这通常说明那里的食物太贵，而且不太好吃。街上一块大招牌，本身并不表示这顿饭就一定好。

paragraphs.en: Good restaurants and street food stalls often become known by word of mouth. Their reputation usually spreads among local people. People who live nearby tell each other where the food is good.
paragraphs.zh: 好的餐厅和街头小吃摊，常常是靠口口相传被人知道的。它们的口碑通常会在当地人中间传开。住在附近的人会互相告诉彼此哪里的食物好吃。

paragraphs.en: Places like that generally do not need aggressive sales tactics for good business. If the food is already well known, they do not have to stop every passer-by.

paragraphs.en: Restaurant reviews can also help you choose a place. They are more reliable when many local people actually write them. sentences.en: Outdoor cooking can be a good experience, but you have to carry more equipment.

paragraphs.en: Dry food, such as cereal, often lasts a long time. Fresh fruit has water in it, but it is bulky and does not last long. Dried fruit is often better on a long journey. Cookies and biscuits also give you energy; their shelf life can be a few days, or more than a year.

paragraphs.en: Many cultures have food taboos: customs about what people will or will not eat. These customs are often connected to religion, and they can be very important to the people who keep them. These are general notes, not a rule for one place, and not a list for one person's diet.
paragraphs.zh: 许多文化里都有饮食禁忌，也就是关于人们会吃什么、不会吃什么的习惯。这些习惯常常和宗教有关，对遵守它们的人来说往往很重要。这些是一般说明，不是某一个地方的规定，也不是某一个人饮食的清单。

sentences.en: Many cultures have food taboos: customs about what people will or will not eat.
sentences.zh: 许多文化里都有饮食禁忌，也就是关于人们会吃什么、不会吃什么的习惯。

sentences.en: These customs are often connected to religion, and they can be very important to the people who keep them.
sentences.zh: 这些习惯常常和宗教有关，对遵守它们的人来说往往很重要。

sentences.en: These are general notes, not a rule for one place, and not a list for one person's diet.
sentences.zh: 这些是一般说明，不是某一个地方的规定，也不是某一个人饮食的清单。

paragraphs.en: Food customs can vary from place to place, and even from person to person. Most of these customs are about meat and other food that comes from animals, so it helps to ask, and to listen carefully. A few people also avoid some vegetables. A person's diet may follow these customs even when they are away from home.
paragraphs.zh: 饮食习惯可能因地而异，甚至因人而异。这类习惯大多和肉，以及其他来自动物的食物有关，所以最好先问清楚，也仔细听。也有少数人会避开某些蔬菜。就算出门在外，一个人的饮食也可能仍然遵守这些习惯。

sentences.en: Food customs can vary from place to place, and even from person to person.
sentences.zh: 饮食习惯可能因地而异，甚至因人而异。

sentences.en: Most of these customs are about meat and other food that comes from animals, so it helps to ask, and to listen carefully.
sentences.zh: 这类习惯大多和肉，以及其他来自动物的食物有关，所以最好先问清楚，也仔细听。

sentences.en: A few people also avoid some vegetables.
sentences.zh: 也有少数人会避开某些蔬菜。

sentences.en: A person's diet may follow these customs even when they are away from home.
sentences.zh: 就算出门在外，一个人的饮食也可能仍然遵守这些习惯。

paragraphs.en: Some foods are avoided because people see them as not clean. Other animals are seen as special, and people do not eat them. You do not need to know every reason, but you should respect the custom.
paragraphs.zh: 有些食物被人避开，是因为他们觉得不干净。还有一些动物被看作很特别，人们不会吃它们。你不必知道每一条理由，但应该尊重这种习惯。

sentences.en: Some foods are avoided because people see them as not clean.
sentences.zh: 有些食物被人避开，是因为他们觉得不干净。

sentences.en: Other animals are seen as special, and people do not eat them.
sentences.zh: 还有一些动物被看作很特别，人们不会吃它们。

sentences.en: You do not need to know every reason, but you should respect the custom.
sentences.zh: 你不必知道每一条理由，但应该尊重这种习惯。

paragraphs.en: Some ingredients in sweets or other ready-made food may come from animals, even when it is not obvious. If you are not sure, it is better to ask, or to choose something else.
paragraphs.zh: 糖果或其他现成食物里的某些成分，也可能来自动物，哪怕看起来并不明显。如果你不确定，最好先问，或者换一样别的。

sentences.en: If you are not sure, it is better to ask, or to choose something else.

paragraphs.en: Some people also have rules about mixing foods. They may not mix meat and dairy, and they may use a separate set of dishes for each. This is a general note, not a rule for one kitchen.

paragraphs.en: Food poisoning and an upset stomach are major concerns when you eat at home or when you go out. These are general notes about staying healthy around food, not medical advice for one person, and not a rule for one kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: 在家吃饭或出门吃饭时，食物中毒和吃完后胃不舒服都是很值得注意的事。这些是关于吃饭时保持健康的一般说明，不是给某一个人的医疗建议，也不是某一个厨房的规定。

sentences.en: Food poisoning and an upset stomach are major concerns when you eat at home or when you go out.

sentences.en: These are general notes about staying healthy around food, not medical advice for one person, and not a rule for one kitchen.
sentences.zh: 这些是关于吃饭时保持健康的一般说明，不是给某一个人的医疗建议，也不是某一个厨房的规定。

paragraphs.en: Food should be kept safe from bugs and other small animals. This matters at home, and it also matters when you take food with you. Keeping food safe is one way to stay healthy, and it can help you avoid food poisoning.
paragraphs.zh: 食物应当保管好，避免虫子和其他小动物碰到。在家是这样，出门带着食物时也是这样。保管好食物是保持健康的一个办法，也可以帮你避免食物中毒。

sentences.en: Keeping food safe is one way to stay healthy, and it can help you avoid food poisoning.
sentences.zh: 保管好食物是保持健康的一个办法，也可以帮你避免食物中毒。

paragraphs.en: An upset stomach after a meal is also a major concern. It can come with food poisoning, and it can also come on its own. This is a general note, not a list of one kind of food, and not a description of one person's illness.
paragraphs.zh: 吃完饭后胃不舒服，同样很值得注意。它可能和食物中毒一起出现，也可能单独出现。这是一般说明，不是某一种食物的清单，也不是对某一个人病情的描述。

paragraphs.en: People who travel often, or who stay away for a long time, may run into another problem. The food along the way can be wonderful, and it is often rich. It is easy to eat too much of it.

difficulty.basisZh: 餐饮说明文体，词汇以健康、安全、胃、额外想吃的东西和食物中毒为主，可与出门带食物、饮食习惯和餐厅客满对照。
difficulty.noteZh: 本篇整体标为常用；配套词仍按词卡三档混出，不替代 levelSuggestionZh。
difficulty.mixPolicyZh: 默认推荐要混着出：能凑齐时大约 2 个基础、4 个常用、2 个进阶；缺档时用相邻档补上，避免一组全是易词或全是难词。用户仍可只学其中一档。
